_comment: Single source of truth for the generated data format, read by src/core/constants.js and scripts/data/*.py. Changing an order here changes the meaning of src/data/items.json: re-run `python scripts/data/regen.py` afterwards. `sources`: bit i of an item row's source mask is sources[i], the groups the Gear pool tab can exclude, in the order the page shows them: set when the piece's category (scripts/data/gear_categories.py) is in `categories`, or when gear_sources.py flags it (crafted, tomestone, ultimate). `currentOnly`: only pieces of the current expansion, whose equip level is the highest in the database. A slot's `blocks` lists the slot types it leaves empty (code 12: a body piece that also covers the head; a `twoHanded` weapon blocks the off-hand). Slot `percent` is the share of the ItemLevel budget in thousandths; gen_item_level.py checks it against the `baseParamColumn` of every stat row in BaseParam.csv. `crafterGathererParams`: crafter and gatherer stats (BaseParam row id and name); gen_items.py leaves out any piece that carries one, normal or HQ, and stops if a row id no longer has that name.

materia._comment: Melding. Item rows carry two more fields at `rowFields`: meldSlots, the item's `slotColumn` (guaranteed slots, 0 to `maxSlots`; gen_items.py stops above it), and overmeld, 1 when its `overmeldColumn` is True (overmelding allowed). The materia table in items.json ({values, gate, high}, one entry per grade I to `grades`) comes from the `sheet` rows whose `statColumn` is one of `statKeys` (BaseParam row ids from `stats`) and whose `itemColumn`[0] is non-zero; rows with values but no items are decoys and are skipped. The rows must agree: values from `valueColumn`[0..grades-1], gate = the `gateColumn` (Item.csv) of each grade's materia item, item and value columns past the last grade all 0, gates non-decreasing. high: the grades whose `highColumn` in `gradeSheet` (row = grade - 1) is 0, which must be the grades worth more than each neighbouring grade.

rarity._comment: Item rows carry the item's `itemColumn` (Item.csv: 1 white, 2 green, 3 blue, 4 purple, 7 pink) at `rowField`; gen_items.py stops on a value that is not a whole number. Used by the accuracy check: green crafted healer gear carries its Direct Hit line at a higher share (formulas.js predictRaw).

statFactor._comment: Per-item stat factor. The last field of an item row is the item's `itemColumn` (Item.csv), an index 0..count-1 into the `baseParamColumn`[0..count-1] columns of BaseParam.csv. Each stat's BaseParam row holds there the percent its full-share slot value is multiplied by on that kind of item (Vitality 90 on Intelligence/Mind gear, every main stat 90 on gear that carries all four). gen_item_level.py writes the table to item-level.json (MP); gen_items.py stops on an index outside it.
